sourceDigestRule: SHA256 of sorted Cargo workspace/lock/manifests and crate .rs files: relative UTF8 path + NUL + contents + NUL
bounds: input and resulting class units*backing checked in i128
zero and excess stored amounts rejected
arithmetic failures return no partial output
limitations: synthetic finite scenarios, not production economic/security proof
rounding can move existing backing into non-distributable residual
P3 must enforce per-owner reservation, lifecycle, supported capacity/admission and atomicity
no venue authentication, Solana deployment or throughput result
deletions: none: Peter candidates scheduled after P3 and still have shared callers
